title_en: Help Us Rank the Biggest Movies and TV Shows From San Diego Comic-Con
summary_en: San Diego Comic-Con was filled with a treasure trove of trailers and we want to know which one was your favorite! Come vote for the best of the best and let us know why, whether it be Avengers: Doomsday, The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power, Blade Runner 2099, or something else!
body_en:
San Diego Comic-Con has come to an end, but not before debuting a treasure trove of trailers for upcoming movies and TV shows. We're very excited about a lot of these projects, including Avengers: Doomsday, Clayface, and The Lord of the Rings: Rings of Power, but this article isn't about us - we want to hear from you!
What were your favorite movies and TV shows from SDCC, and which didn't quite reach the levels of hype you were hoping they would? Did Resident Evil scare you in the best ways? Did the long-awaited glimpse of Blade Runner 2099 make you instantly jump back into the original or Blade Runner 2049? We want to know!
We've selected some of the most popular movies and TV shows in the poll below, and we'd love to know which was your favorite! After you vote, be sure to go into the comments and defend your pick!
For more, check out the rest of the biggest trailers from SDCC and all our roundup of all the news from the weekend!
